# “En signal för att börsen ska upp”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this EFN morning show the hosts cover Wall Street's sharp intraday reversal. The S&P 500 was down nearly 4% at one point but closed only 0.3% lower, a turn linked partly to Michael Burry saying he had covered his short positions. They read the extreme-fear sentiment and a VIX near 30 as a contrarian signal that the market should rise, and Stockholm looks set to open about 1.7% higher. They also discuss tighter US chip-export rules hitting Chinese AI firms, Nvidia stopping chip shipments to four Southeast Asian countries, a South Korean rate hike and expected Fed hikes, Note's CEO leaving with immediate effect, the SKF Vertevo spin-off and some relief in copper prices for mining stocks.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 BOL — Boliden | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

The hosts suggest keeping an eye on mining stocks as copper ticks up after falling sharply in recent weeks.

#### Reasoning

The hosts make a short-term observation: copper has bounced a little after a steep slide, which could give Boliden a breather. This is a tentative 'worth watching' remark, not a recommendation, and it depends on copper prices.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the copper price resumes its decline

> *"Så kanske lite välbehövligt andningsuppehåll för Boliden och Lundin Mining då framförallt här på Stockholm."*

---

### 🟠 LUMI — Lundin Mining | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Named with Boliden as a mining stock that may get relief from the copper rebound.

#### Reasoning

Lundin Mining is sensitive to copper prices. The hosts tentatively flag a possible breather after copper's steep recent fall. This is a short-term watch only, with no stated conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the copper price resumes its decline

> *"Så kanske lite välbehövligt andningsuppehåll för Boliden och Lundin Mining då framförallt här på Stockholm."*

---

### 🟠 SKF-B — SKF | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

SKF trades ex the right to Vertevo shares today, ahead of the December 1 spin-off. The hosts say to watch the share price to gauge Vertevo's value.

#### Reasoning

This is an event-driven watch. The ex-date price move indicates how the market values the spun-off automotive unit SKF Vertevo. The hosts take no directional stance.

> *"Men jag tänker att det blir ju extra viktigt att hålla koll på aktiekursen idag för att se värdet på SKF Bertevo."*
